prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years delivering production-grade full‑stack platforms and AI‑agent workflows. Built serverless edge applications in Python and TypeScript that generate interactive demos in about one minute. Designed multi‑stage agent pipelines with automated verification to prevent hallucinations. Integrated custom data ingestion and analytics pipelines that cut service delivery time by more than 30% and reduced processing overhead by 68%.

bullets.text: Designed a six‑stage agent pipeline (intake, collect, brief, config, verify, publish) using Interpretable Context Methodology to enforce automated verification and prevent hallucinated pricing.
Built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that transforms business URLs into shoppable 3D scroll demos in about one minute on Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2 and D1.
Engineered tycodes.dev on edge infrastructure with Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind and a Hono Worker running Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audit and pricing models.
Architected and deployed linkme‑intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface for high‑value subscription accounts.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, reducing service delivery times by more than 30%.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to reliably onboard high‑value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Led end‑to‑end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud‑native web infrastructure, lowering manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Constructed database‑layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Managed over $100M of federal inventory across 12 regional sites serving more than 8,000 personnel daily, maintaining 100% audit accuracy and cutting processing times by 35%.
Enforced rigorous accountability procedures to remove supply chain bottlenecks during high‑demand deployment rotations; received the Army Achievement Medal in 2018 for operational excellence.
